title: Google's Gemini Agent Can Work on One Task for Days
description:
Google Cloud announced Gemini agent on October 8: one 'universal agent for work' that answers questions, drafts documents, writes code, and can run tasks for hours or even days with temporary helper agents.
It picks the best model for each job, including Gemini and Anthropic's Claude. For now it is a private preview for business customers.
